title.en: Police smash two phone-scam call centres and arrest 123 people in HK$68 million fraud crackdown, as phone scams cost HK$1.9 billion in first nine months
title.zh_hant: 警搗破兩電騙中心拘123人 涉款6800萬 今年首三季電話騙案損失高達19億
title.zh_hans: 警捣破两电骗中心拘123人 涉款6800万 今年首三季电话骗案损失高达19亿

summary.en: Police have arrested 123 people and cracked 108 fraud cases worth about HK$68 million in an operation against telephone scams and money laundering this month. Officers raided scam call centres in two industrial units in Hung Hom and Kwun Tong; most of those arrested were mule account holders or people who registered the scam phone numbers. Police said nearly 10,000 telephone fraud cases were recorded in the first three quarters of this year, about 30 per cent of all fraud cases, with losses of HK$1.9 billion. Impersonating customer service staff is the most common tactic, with fraudsters claiming there is a problem with goods or services to trick victims into transferring money, and police urged the industry to step up customer checks and monitoring of abnormal number use.
summary.zh_hant: 警方本月展開打擊電話騙案及洗黑錢行動，拘捕123人，偵破108宗騙案，涉及款項約6,800萬元。行動搗破紅磡及觀塘兩個工廈單位內的詐騙電話操作中心，被捕者大部分是傀儡戶口持有人或詐騙電話登記人。警方表示，本港今年首三季已錄得接近1萬宗電話騙案，佔整體詐騙案三成，損失金額達19億元；假冒客服是最常見手法，騙徒訛稱貨品或服務有問題誘使市民轉帳，呼籲業界加強客戶審核及監察異常號碼使用。
summary.zh_hans: 警方本月展开打击电话骗案及洗黑钱行动，拘捕123人，侦破108宗骗案，涉及款项约6,800万元。行动捣破红磡及观塘两个工厦单位内的诈骗电话操作中心，被捕者大部分是傀儡户口持有人或诈骗电话登记人。警方表示，本港今年首三季已录得接近1万宗电话骗案，占整体诈骗案三成，损失金额达19亿元；假冒客服是最常见手法，骗徒讹称货品或服务有问题诱使市民转账，呼吁业界加强客户审核及监察异常号码使用。

title.en: Abby Choi murder trial: Kwong Kau insists he did not lie as cross-examination continues, third defendant Kwong Kong-chi takes the stand before noon
title.zh_hant: 蔡天鳳案鄺球續作供堅稱無說謊 第三被告鄺港智中午前開始作供
title.zh_hans: 蔡天凤案邝球续作供坚称无说谎 第三被告邝港智中午前开始作供

summary.en: The trial of the Abby Choi murder case continued at the High Court, with second defendant Kwong Kau continuing his testimony. Prosecutors questioned a series of events they said were not coincidences but linked to Choi’s death, including buying a phone card for third defendant Kwong Kong-chi, renting flats at The Arch and in Lung Mei Tsuen, and buying tools on Shanghai Street. Kwong denied the prosecution’s inferences, saying whether they were coincidences was a matter of opinion, and said the Shanghai Street tools were for renovation and that he rented the Lung Mei Tsuen village house to exercise for his health. Kwong also said he did not know why the body was cooked and did not remember the disposal process, saying he had a mental breakdown at the time but did not lie. Third defendant Kwong Kong-chi began giving evidence before noon.
summary.zh_hant: 蔡天鳳案在高等法院續審，第二被告鄺球繼續作供。控方質疑多項事件並非巧合而是與蔡天鳳死亡有關，包括為第三被告鄺港智購買電話卡、租用凱旋門及龍尾村單位，以及在上海街購買器具；鄺球否認控方推論，稱是否巧合見仁見智，又指上海街器具用作裝修，租用龍尾村村屋是為做運動養生。鄺球又供稱不知為何烹煮屍體、不記得處置過程，稱當時精神崩潰但並無說謊。中午前第三被告鄺港智開始作供。
summary.zh_hans: 蔡天凤案在高等法院续审，第二被告邝球继续作供。控方质疑多项事件并非巧合而是与蔡天凤死亡有关，包括为第三被告邝港智购买电话卡、租用凯旋门及龙尾村单位，以及在上海街购买器具；邝球否认控方推论，称是否巧合见仁见智，又指上海街器具用作装修，租用龙尾村村屋是为做运动养生。邝球又供称不知为何烹煮尸体、不记得处置过程，称当时精神崩溃但并无说谎。中午前第三被告邝港智开始作供。

title.en: Hang Seng falls 439 points at midday and loses 23,000 mark as Tencent slumps nearly 7% and Alibaba drops almost 6%

summary.en: Hong Kong stocks lost the 23,000 mark in early trading, with the Hang Seng Index falling to the edge of 22,800, down nearly 500 points, before closing the morning session at 22,855, down 439 points or 1.89 per cent, on turnover of nearly HK$123.4 billion. The tech index fell 2 per cent to 3,661, with most ATMXJ stocks lower; Tencent fell nearly 7 per cent and Alibaba nearly 6 per cent, the two worst-performing blue chips, while JD.com rose nearly 1 per cent against the trend. Heavyweight financial stocks also fell, with HSBC, AIA and HKEX all down nearly 2 per cent; chip stocks were mixed, with Hua Hong surging 14 per cent and Tianshu Zhixin plunging 21 per cent.

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee attended the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting in Shenzhen this morning. President Xi Jinping, who chaired the meeting, had a brief chat with Lee before the session, with both wearing red scarves symbolising Shenzhen’s “Kunpeng spreading its wings” emblem. Leaders then posed for a group photo, with Xi standing in the centre of the front row, US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin on either side, and Lee in the back row beside Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi.
summary.zh_hant: 行政長官李家超早上在深圳出席亞太區經濟合作組織第三十三次領導人非正式會議。主持會議的國家主席習近平與李家超在會議前短暫交談，二人均戴上象徵深圳「鯤鵬展翅」標誌的紅色圍巾。各經濟體領導人入場後集體合影，習近平站在前排正中位置，左右兩旁分別是美國總統特朗普和俄羅斯總統普京，李家超站在後排，身旁是日本首相高市早苗。
summary.zh_hans: 行政长官李家超早上在深圳出席亚太区经济合作组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议。主持会议的国家主席习近平与李家超在会议前短暂交谈，二人均戴上象征深圳「鲲鹏展翅」标志的红色围巾。各经济体领导人入场后集体合影，习近平站在前排正中位置，左右两旁分别是美国总统特朗普和俄罗斯总统普京，李家超站在后排，身旁是日本首相高市早苗。

title.en: Christopher Hui promotes Hong Kong’s financial strengths in Luxembourg, meets finance officials on green and digital finance before heading to Brussels
title.zh_hant: 許正宇盧森堡推介香港金融優勢 晤財金官員倡綠色數字金融合作 轉赴布魯塞爾
title.zh_hans: 许正宇卢森堡推介香港金融优势 晤财金官员倡绿色数字金融合作 转赴布鲁塞尔

summary.en: Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui began the second leg of his European duty visit in Luxembourg on November 18 (Luxembourg time), meeting government officials, financial regulators, banks and financial institutions. He called on Luxembourg’s Ministry of Finance and met Secretary General and Director of the Treasury Bob Kieffer, highlighting Hong Kong’s strategic direction under its first Five-Year Plan and the city’s role as an international financial centre and global offshore renminbi hub. Hui also met the chief executives of Luxembourg for Finance and the Association of the Luxembourg Fund Industry, and attended a roundtable luncheon with banking and wealth management representatives, saying Luxembourg and Hong Kong are well placed as strategic partners in wealth management and green and digital finance. He continues his visit in Brussels today.
summary.zh_hant: 財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇11月18日（盧森堡時間）在盧森堡展開歐洲外訪第二站，會晤當地政府官員、金融監管機構、銀行及金融機構。他拜會盧森堡財政部，與秘書長兼國庫署署長 Bob Kieffer 會面，介紹香港在首個五年規劃下的策略方向，以及香港作為國際金融中心和全球離岸人民幣樞紐的角色。許正宇亦會見盧森堡金融推廣署及盧森堡基金業協會的行政總裁，並出席銀行業及財富管理界圓桌午宴，指盧森堡與香港在財富管理及綠色與數字金融方面可成為策略伙伴。他今日轉往布魯塞爾繼續訪問。
summary.zh_hans: 财经事务及库务局局长许正宇11月18日（卢森堡时间）在卢森堡展开欧洲外访第二站，会晤当地政府官员、金融监管机构、银行及金融机构。他拜会卢森堡财政部，与秘书长兼国库署署长 Bob Kieffer 会面，介绍香港在首个五年规划下的策略方向，以及香港作为国际金融中心和全球离岸人民币枢纽的角色。许正宇亦会见卢森堡金融推广署及卢森堡基金业协会的行政总裁，并出席银行业及财富管理界圆桌午宴，指卢森堡与香港在财富管理及绿色与数字金融方面可成为策略伙伴。他今日转往布鲁塞尔继续访问。

title.en: Star Ferry Pier car park to be demolished once public parking opens at Central Site 3, with monthly rentals replacing quarterly terms from January
title.zh_hant: 天星碼頭停車場將拆卸 中環三號用地公眾泊車位啟用後停運 月租明年1月改制
title.zh_hans: 天星码头停车场将拆卸 中环三号用地公众泊车位启用后停运 月租明年1月改制

summary.en: The Transport Department said the Star Ferry Pier car park at Edinburgh Place in Central will stop operating and be demolished once public parking spaces at Central’s Site 3 open, to make way for the new Central harbourfront development. Quarterly parking rentals at the car park will switch to monthly sales from January, and from February all spaces will be hourly only. Applications for January monthly parking at the Star Ferry Pier car park will be accepted from tomorrow until December 4.
summary.zh_hant: 運輸署表示，為配合中環新海濱三號用地的發展，位於中環愛丁堡廣場的天星碼頭停車場將於三號用地的公眾泊車位啟用後，停止營運並拆卸。該停車場以往提供的季租泊車服務名額將於明年1月份改為月租方式銷售，2月份起所有泊車位只提供時租安排。天星碼頭停車場1月份的月租服務將於明日至下月4日期間接受申請。
summary.zh_hans: 运输署表示，为配合中环新海滨三号用地的发展，位于中环爱丁堡广场的天星码头停车场将于三号用地的公众泊车位启用后，停止营运并拆卸。该停车场以往提供的季租泊车服务名额将于明年1月份改为月租方式销售，2月份起所有泊车位只提供时租安排。天星码头停车场1月份的月租服务将于明日至下月4日期间接受申请。

title.en: Hong Kong’s computing power reaches 5,000 PFLOPS as Sandy Ridge data cluster adds 180,000 more by 2032 to back open-source AI
title.zh_hant: 港算力達5000 PFLOPS 沙嶺數據設施2032年再添18萬 配合開源AI發展
title.zh_hans: 港算力达5000 PFLOPS 沙岭数据设施2032年再添18万 配合开源AI发展

summary.en: Permanent Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Kevin Choi told a United Nations workshop on open-source AI that Hong Kong’s overall computing capacity has reached 5,000 PFLOPS, including 3,000 PFLOPS from Cyberport’s AI Supercomputing Centre. The Sandy Ridge Data Facility Cluster now under construction is expected to provide an additional 180,000 PFLOPS by 2032, 36 times the city’s current capacity. Choi said open-source AI lowers barriers to innovation and widens access to AI technologies, and that Hong Kong is well placed to serve as a bridge between the Mainland and the world under the nation’s Global AI Governance Initiative, advancing the AI+ Initiative through its first Five-Year Plan.
summary.zh_hant: 創新科技及工業局常任秘書長蔡傑銘在聯合國開源人工智能研討會致開幕辭表示，香港整體算力已達 5,000 PFLOPS，包括數碼港人工智能超算中心的 3,000 PFLOPS。正在興建的沙嶺數據設施群落預計 2032 年前額外提供 180,000 PFLOPS，是現時全港算力的 36 倍。蔡傑銘表示，開源人工智能降低創新門檻、擴大技術普及，香港在國家全球人工智能治理倡議下，可發揮連接內地與世界的橋樑角色，並透過首個五年規劃推動「人工智能+」倡議。
summary.zh_hans: 创新科技及工业局常任秘书长蔡杰铭在联合国开源人工智能研讨会致开幕辞表示，香港整体算力已达 5,000 PFLOPS，包括数码港人工智能超算中心的 3,000 PFLOPS。正在兴建的沙岭数据设施群落预计 2032 年前额外提供 180,000 PFLOPS，是现时全港算力的 36 倍。蔡杰铭表示，开源人工智能降低创新门槛、扩大技术普及，香港在国家全球人工智能治理倡议下，可发挥连接内地与世界的桥梁角色，并透过首个五年规划推动「人工智能+」倡议。

title.en: Paul Chan: intellectual property disputes can be settled through Hong Kong arbitration as patent team expands towards self-examination by 2030
title.zh_hant: 陳茂波：知識產權爭議可經香港仲裁解決 專利審查團隊擴充 目標2030年自行審查
title.zh_hans: 陈茂波：知识产权争议可经香港仲裁解决 专利审查团队扩充 目标2030年自行审查

summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan told the opening ceremony of the 16th Business of Intellectual Property Asia Forum that the nation’s 15th Five-Year Plan supports Hong Kong in becoming a regional intellectual property trading centre, and Hong Kong’s first Five-Year Plan sets out how this will be done, including bringing finance closer to intellectual property and lowering the cost of holding and trading it. The intellectual property financing sandbox launched with the Monetary Authority last December has approved its first seven loans, with the next phase set to attract more participants, and a new pilot scheme will help SMEs obtain professional valuations for patents under national standards. Hong Kong is expanding its patent examination team with the aim of examining patent applications in major technology fields itself by 2030; the current patent box regime taxes qualifying intellectual property profits at 5 per cent, and the Legislative Council is considering a bill to widen tax deductions. Chan stressed that intellectual property disputes can be resolved in Hong Kong through arbitration or mediation under the common law system.
summary.zh_hant: 財政司司長陳茂波出席第16屆亞洲知識產權營商論壇開幕式致辭表示，國家十五五規劃支持香港建設成為區域知識產權貿易中心，香港首個五年規劃亦說明具體做法，包括將金融與知識產權的距離拉近，以及降低持有和交易知識產權的成本。政府去年12月與金管局推出的知識產權融資沙盒，已有首批7筆貸款獲批，下一階段將吸引更多參與者，另有新先導計劃協助中小企按國家標準為專利取得專業估值。香港正擴充專利審查團隊，目標到2030年自行審查主要科技領域的專利申請；現行「專利盒」制度讓合資格知識產權利潤按5%稅率繳稅，立法會正審議擴大扣稅範圍的條例草案。陳茂波強調，知識產權爭議可以在香港透過仲裁或調解，在普通法制度下解決。
summary.zh_hans: 财政司司长陈茂波出席第16届亚洲知识产权营商论坛开幕式致辞表示，国家十五五规划支持香港建设成为区域知识产权贸易中心，香港首个五年规划亦说明具体做法，包括将金融与知识产权的距离拉近，以及降低持有和交易知识产权的成本。政府去年12月与金管局推出的知识产权融资沙盒，已有首批7笔贷款获批，下一阶段将吸引更多参与者，另有新先导计划协助中小企按国家标准为专利取得专业估值。香港正扩充专利审查团队，目标到2030年自行审查主要科技领域的专利申请；现行「专利盒」制度让合资格知识产权利润按5%税率缴税，立法会正审议扩大扣税范围的条例草案。陈茂波强调，知识产权争议可以在香港透过仲裁或调解，在普通法制度下解决。

summary.en: President Xi Jinping chaired the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Informal Meeting in Shenzhen and announced that China will provide US$20 million to fund practical APEC cooperation. China will also set up an APEC Community research centre in Shenzhen to carry out policy research and exchanges. Xi said China will work with all parties to build the Asia-Pacific community around four pillars: trade, connectivity, innovation and development, including new cooperation bodies in digital technology, cross-border data flows, clean energy and small business development.
summary.zh_hans: 国家主席习近平在深圳主持亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议并发表重要讲话，宣布中方将提供2000万美元，资助开展亚太经合组织务实合作，并将在深圳设立亚太共同体研究中心，开展政策研究和交流。习近平表示，中方愿同各方携手搭建亚太共同体的“四梁八柱”，包括强化经贸、联通、创新和发展四大支柱，并在数字技术、数据跨境流动、清洁能源和中小企业发展等领域设立合作机构。
summary.zh_hant: 國家主席習近平在深圳主持亞太經合組織第三十三次領導人非正式會議並發表重要講話，宣布中方將提供2000萬美元，資助開展亞太經合組織務實合作，並將在深圳設立亞太共同體研究中心，開展政策研究和交流。習近平表示，中方願同各方攜手搭建亞太共同體的「四梁八柱」，包括強化經貿、聯通、創新和發展四大支柱，並在數字技術、數據跨境流動、清潔能源和中小企業發展等領域設立合作機構。

title.en: Xi pledges US$20 million for APEC cooperation as Shenzhen summit opens, research centre to be set up in the city
title.zh_hans: 习近平深圳主持APEC峰会 宣布掏2000万美元资助合作 深圳设研究中心
title.zh_hant: 習近平深圳主持APEC峰會 宣布掏2000萬美元資助合作 深圳設研究中心

summary.en: CUHK Hospital chief executive Chung Kin-lai has given a fresh account of how a woman lost both ovaries by mistake during laparoscopic surgery, telling RTHK's Millennium programme that the surgeon lost focus after taking 15 to 20 minutes to get the laparoscope into position. The hospital has now introduced new safeguards, including a paper listing the most important steps placed under the laparoscope screen and nurses reminding doctors at key stages, measures that will be extended to other operations. Disciplinary proceedings against the surgeon, gynaecological oncology specialist Dr Cheung Tak-hong, are under way and the outcome will be told to the patient and her family.
summary.zh_hans: 中大医院行政总裁钟健礼在港台节目《千禧年代》再次就女病人被错切卵巢事件致歉，并亲述事发经过：负责手术的医生利用腹腔镜进入手术位置时出现困难，需要15至20分钟，之后专注力突然降低，然后出错。医院现时已采取防错措施，包括在腹腔镜手术的镜头屏幕下贴纸张，列出手术最重要步骤提醒医生，重要步骤护士亦会提醒医生，并将措施扩展至其他手术。涉事医生、妇科肿瘤科专科医生张德康的惩处问题，院方正进行人事程序，会将惩处告知病人及家属。
summary.zh_hant: 中大醫院行政總裁鍾健禮在港台節目《千禧年代》再次就女病人被錯切卵巢事件致歉，並親述事發經過：負責手術的醫生利用腹腔鏡進入手術位置時出現困難，需要15至20分鐘，之後專注力突然降低，然後出錯。醫院現時已採取防錯措施，包括在腹腔鏡手術的鏡頭屏幕下貼紙張，列出手術最重要步驟提醒醫生，重要步驟護士亦會提醒醫生，並將措施擴展至其他手術。涉事醫生、婦科腫瘤科專科醫生張德康的懲處問題，院方正進行人事程序，會將懲處告知病人及家屬。

title.en: Surgeon 'lost focus' in wrong-ovary blunder, CUHK Hospital chief reveals, as new safety checks rolled out
title.zh_hans: 错切卵巢医生手术中“失神” 中大医院院长亲述经过 新防错措施已上路
title.zh_hant: 錯切卵巢醫生手術中「失神」 中大醫院院長親述經過 新防錯措施已上路

summary.en: US President Donald Trump has said he will not ask China or Russia for help in ending the war with Iran, telling Fox News in Shenzhen: "We don't need any help." Speaking before Thursday's trilateral meeting with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin, Trump said Iran wants a deal and claimed the United States has defeated Iran's navy, air force and army and now has full control of the Strait of Hormuz. He added that Tehran has treated Washington well, saying Iran has not fired on American forces or sunk American ships.
summary.zh_hans: 美国总统特朗普在深圳接受福斯新闻访问时表示，不会寻求中国或俄罗斯协助结束与伊朗的战事，称“我们不需要任何帮助”。特朗普在周四与习近平和普京举行三方会谈前表示，伊朗希望达成协议，又声称美国已击败伊朗海军、空军和陆军，现时完全掌控荷姆兹海峡。他又说，伊朗对美国态度很好，既没有向美军开火，也没有击沉美方船只。
summary.zh_hant: 美國總統特朗普在深圳接受霍士新聞訪問時表示，不會尋求中國或俄羅斯協助結束與伊朗的戰事，稱「我們不需要任何幫助」。特朗普在周四與習近平和普京舉行三方會談前表示，伊朗希望達成協議，又聲稱美國已擊敗伊朗海軍、空軍和陸軍，現時完全掌控荷姆茲海峽。他又說，伊朗對美國態度很好，既沒有向美軍開火，也沒有擊沉美方船隻。

title.en: London ETO promotes Hong Kong I&T opportunities at Finland's Slush 2026, opening Asia's door for Nordic start-ups
title.zh_hant: 倫敦經貿辦芬蘭 Slush 推介香港創科機遇 北歐初創借港進軍亞洲市場
title.zh_hans: 伦敦经贸办芬兰 Slush 推介香港创科机遇 北欧初创借港进军亚洲市场

summary.en: Hong Kong's London Economic and Trade Office teamed up with Invest Hong Kong, the Trade Development Council and the Science and Technology Parks Corporation to host a seminar at Slush 2026 in Helsinki, promoting Hong Kong as a launch pad for Nordic start-ups expanding into Asia. Director-General Fiona Chau outlined Hong Kong's vision of becoming an international innovation and technology centre under its First Five-Year Plan, including three major I&T parks and five key research institutions. She also highlighted the Northern Metropolis and the Hetao co-operation zone's 'one river, two banks; one zone, two parks' model, which lets Nordic firms base themselves in Hong Kong and tap the Greater Bay Area's technology and manufacturing strengths.
summary.zh_hant: 香港駐倫敦經濟貿易辦事處聯同投資推廣署、貿發局及香港科技園公司，喺芬蘭赫爾辛基 Slush 2026 舉辦研討會，推廣香港創科發展同北歐初創進軍亞洲市場嘅機遇。倫敦經貿辦處長周雪鳳介紹香港喺《第一個五年規劃》下發展成為國際創科中心嘅願景，包括三個主要創科園區同五個重點研發機構。佢亦介紹北部都會區同河套深港科技創新合作區「一河兩岸、一區兩園」嘅合作模式，等北歐企業可以喺香港落腳，善用大灣區嘅科技同製造優勢。
summary.zh_hans: 香港驻伦敦经济贸易办事处联同投资推广署、贸发局及香港科技园公司，在芬兰赫尔辛基 Slush 2026 举办研讨会，推广香港创科发展和北欧初创进军亚洲市场的机遇。伦敦经贸办处长周雪凤介绍香港在《第一个五年规划》下发展成为国际创科中心的愿景，包括三个主要创科园区和五个重点研发机构。她亦介绍北部都会区和河套深港科技创新合作区「一河两岸、一区两园」的合作模式，让北欧企业可以在香港落脚，善用大湾区的科技和制造优势。

summary.en: For the second consecutive day, a signal equipment fault near HKU station has disrupted the Island Line. summary.en: AI company Anthropic has priced its initial public offering at US$83 a share, above its original US$70 to US$78 range, and expects to raise about US$81.3 billion, with shares listing on Nasdaq today. The company is issuing 980 million Class A shares, of which more than 956 million are being sold by the company, with the rest sold by some existing shareholders, and underwriters have a 30-day option to buy up to 147 million more shares. Excluding the greenshoe, Anthropic’s fundraising already exceeds the US$75 billion record set by SpaceX in its June listing; if the option is exercised, its total could pass SpaceX’s US$85.7 billion and become the largest IPO ever.
summary.zh_hant: 人工智能公司Anthropic公布，首次公開發售每股定價83美元，高於原先設定的每股70至78美元，預計上市集資約813億美元，股份將於今日在納斯達克掛牌。集團今次發行9.8億股A類普通股，當中逾9.56億股由公司出售，其餘由部分售股股東出售，並已授予承銷商超額配股權，可在30日內決定是否額外購買最多1.47億股。若不計行使超額配售權，Anthropic的集資規模已超越SpaceX於6月上市創下的750億美元紀錄；行使後總集資額有望超越SpaceX的857億美元，創歷來最大IPO集資規模。

summary.en: A strong northeast monsoon is affecting the Guangdong coast, and temperatures across Hong Kong this morning are about 3 to 4 degrees lower than yesterday. The Observatory says the monsoon and a band of cloud will make southern China significantly cooler today and tomorrow, quite cool on the coast and cold in inland areas in the mornings. The cloud is expected to thin over the weekend, bringing a large day-night temperature difference with mornings still quite cool. An easterly airstream early next week will bring more cloud and slightly higher temperatures, before another northeast monsoon arrives mid-next week, bringing another drop in temperature and a few showers.

summary.en: The US-China Economic and Security Review Commission said in its annual report, published on November 18, that China's military is seeking advanced Nvidia chips for use in AI-enabled weapons, because Chinese-made processors still lag behind US rivals. The report says Beijing is trying to circumvent US export controls to obtain the advanced semiconductors it considers vital to 'intelligentised warfare' — the PLA term for integrating AI into weapons, command and control, kill chains and logistics. It also notes that Huawei's Ascend and Cambricon's Siyuan chips still trail Nvidia and AMD products. Reuters found that more than US$3 billion worth of computing projects in China use Nvidia's restricted chips, despite Nvidia saying export controls had effectively shut it out of China's AI data-centre market. Washington announced on November 16 that it would further restrict China's access to advanced chips from Nvidia and other companies.
summary.zh_hans: 美国政府独立机构“美中经济与安全检讨委员会”18日发布年度报告指出，由于中国制处理器持续落后美国对手，中国军方正寻求取得Nvidia先进芯片，要用于具备AI功能的武器。报告表示，北京当局正试图避开美国出口管制，以取得对中方推动“智能化战争”至关重要的先进半导体；“智能化战争”是解放军的用语，用来描述把人工智能整合进入武器、指挥管制、击杀链及后勤。报告还提到，华为昇腾和寒武纪思元系列等中国本土AI芯片，仍落后于美国Nvidia与超微更先进产品。路透检视后发现，中国有超过30亿美元的运算项目使用Nvidia受管制芯片，尽管Nvidia曾宣称出口管制实际上已让公司被排除在中国AI数据中心市场之外。华府于16日宣布，将进一步限制中国取得Nvidia在内多家公司先进芯片的管道。
summary.zh_hant: 美國政府獨立機構「美中經濟暨安全檢討委員會」18日發布年度報告指出，由於中國製處理器持續落後美國對手，中國軍方正尋求取得Nvidia先進晶片，要用於具備AI功能之武器。報告表示，北京當局正試圖避開美國出口管制，以取得對中方推動「智能化戰爭」至關重要的先進半導體；「智能化戰爭」是解放軍的用語，用來描述把人工智能整合進入武器、指揮管制、擊殺鏈及後勤。報告還提到，華為昇騰和寒武紀思元系列等中國本土AI晶片，仍落後於美國Nvidia與超微更先進產品。路透檢視後發現，中國有超過30億美元的運算項目使用Nvidia受管制晶片，儘管Nvidia曾宣稱出口管制實際上已讓公司被排除在中國AI資料中心市場之外。華府於16日宣布，將進一步限制中國取得Nvidia在內多家公司先進晶片的管道。

summary.en: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen on November 18, their first meeting since Lee took office and the first face-to-face encounter between South Korean and Russian leaders in about seven and a half years. According to a senior presidential office official, the two spoke for about 10 minutes at the APEC leaders' welcome banquet hosted by Xi Jinping, agreeing to seek cooperation where possible, manage bilateral ties, and prevent the situation on the Korean Peninsula from worsening, with a brief exchange on North Korea's nuclear weapons development. Lee also spoke with US President Donald Trump across the table about future diplomatic schedules and South Korea-US cooperation, without directly raising US-North Korea dialogue.

summary.en: Oil prices fell again as data showed US crude and fuel inventories rising more than expected, deepening oversupply concerns. Brent crude for January fell as much as 3% to a low of US$90.34 a barrel before closing at US$91.95, down about 1.3%. NYMEX crude for December at one point plunged about 4.7%, breaking below US$82 a barrel to a near three-month low, before closing at US$83.26, down about 3.2%. US Energy Information Administration data showed gasoline inventories up about 5.2 million barrels last week, distillate inventories up about 1.6 million barrels and crude inventories up about 3.4 million barrels last week, all above expectations.

summary.en: The three major US indices moved in different directions after Federal Reserve minutes showed officials were already leaning towards a rate hike — even by 0.5 percentage points — before data showed inflation heating up. The Dow tested the 50,000 level, falling as much as 730 points before closing at 50,198, down 561 points or 1.1%, a third straight daily fall and an over five-month low. The S&P 500 fell for a fifth straight session to 7,323, down over 0.2% to a near four-month low, while the Nasdaq rebounded to 24,429, up over 0.4%. Nvidia fell nearly 3%, down for five straight sessions and about 37% below its early-October closing record high.

summary.en: Grand Theft Auto VI has launched worldwide, unlocking at midnight local time on Thursday, November 19, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S players after a 13-year wait since GTA V. The rollout began in New Zealand and Australia and moved across Asia and the Middle East, with early reports of stable servers and no major outages. Market research firm Sensor Tower estimates the game has already sold about 17 million copies worth more than US$1.65 billion in pre-orders, though Rockstar and publisher Take-Two have not confirmed the figures. Reviewers have praised the game, with Metacritic averaging it at 99 out of 100, while no PC version has been announced.

summary.en: The US Democratic Party has nominated House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries for Speaker of the House of Representatives, and he is poised to become the first Black Speaker in American history. The House Democratic caucus approved the nomination in a closed-door vote on Wednesday, but Jeffries still needs majority support in a full House vote in January next year before he can formally take the post. The Democrats retook control of both chambers of Congress in the midterm elections earlier this month, with the new Congress starting its term on 3 January.

summary.en: Panama's comptroller general has filed a criminal complaint over suspected irregularities found in an audit of the port concession contract with Panama Ports Company, the CK Hutchison unit that used to operate the Balboa and Cristobal ports at either end of the Panama Canal. The complaint, filed with the Public Ministry on November 17, also names former board members and administrators of the Panama Maritime Authority who served from 2014 to 2023. The audit covered the company's operations from 2014 to 2024, and the comptroller says the state failed to receive US$1.337 billion. Panama's Supreme Court declared the concession unconstitutional in January 2026, and the company is seeking more than US$2 billion in international arbitration, while CK Hutchison has a separate treaty claim of more than US$1.5 billion. The company and its parent, CK Hutchison, have rejected the government's actions, saying the termination of the concession violated their contractual rights.

summary.en: China and South Korea have substantively concluded the second phase of negotiations on their free trade agreement, the Ministry of Commerce said. The talks, guided by the consensus reached by the two countries' leaders, took more than eight years. The upgrade covers the investment, services trade, financial services and economic cooperation chapters of the original agreement, raising the level of investment and services liberalisation and facilitation, and adopts a negative-list model for opening commitments in investment, cross-border services trade and financial services, setting transparent, stable and predictable market-access rules for two-way investment and services trade. The two sides also agreed on implementation arrangements for economic cooperation, including traditional medicine services, cultural cooperation and internet services.
summary.zh_hans: 商务部表示，中韩双方以两国元首重要共识为指引，推进中韩自贸协定第二阶段谈判，历经8年多时间，在近日实质性完成，达成互利共赢的高水平谈判成果。中韩自贸协定第二阶段对原中韩自贸协定投资、服务贸易、金融服务和经济合作章及有关附件进行升级，进一步提升了双方投资和服务自由化、便利化规则水平，并采用负面清单模式针对投资、跨境服务贸易、金融服务等领域作出开放承诺，为后续双向投资和服务贸易往来建立了透明、稳定、可预期的准入规则。另外，双方又制定了经济合作领域具体实施安排，涵盖传统医学服务合作、文化合作和网络服务合作等内容。

summary.en: The South Pacific island nation of Fiji has declared a nationwide state of disaster as it battles a rare prolonged drought and a severe water shortage. Prime Minister Sitiveni Rabuka said the declaration allows the government to centrally deploy emergency teams, relief supplies and public resources, and that special relief funds have been set aside for emergency water supply, help for affected communities, and relief for agriculture and livestock. Authorities warn that 75 per cent of water sources will be at warning level by the end of November, and the figure could exceed 82 per cent by next January, leaving more than 80 per cent of the country's water supply at risk of running dry.

summary.en: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said inflation is still heading in the wrong direction and spreading, and the Fed should act more aggressively, including considering a half-point rate rise in December or clearly signalling faster hikes next year. He said the recent annualised inflation rate has exceeded 3 per cent and may be accelerating, driven mainly by services, and warned that if company managers treat it as normal and pass it on to consumers, it will become harder to contain. Waller said the market needs to understand that 3 per cent inflation is not the Fed's target, and expectations of only one quarter-point rise should be overturned.
summary.zh_hans: 美国联储局理事沃勒表示，通胀仍在朝错误的方向发展，而且正在蔓延，联储局应采取更进取的措施应对，包括考虑在12月加息半厘，或者明确表达明年将加快加息步伐。沃勒接受外电访问时表示，近期的年化通胀率已超过3%，并可能正在加速，而且价格升势主要受服务业影响，认为与高油价及其他短暂性因素影响有限，忧虑企业管理层会视之为常态，并转嫁予消费者，到时要压抑通胀就会变得困难。他又说，市场对当前价格水平的接受程度超出预期，有需要让市场意识到3%的通胀率并非当局的目标水平，并推翻市场对于联储局只会加息1次、加幅只有0.25厘的预期。

summary.en: A first-alarm fire broke out in the evening in a flat in Chim Uk Tsuen, Shuen Wan, Tai Po. summary.en: A 45-year-old woman had both ovaries wrongly removed during laparoscopic surgery to remove her uterus and fallopian tubes at CUHK Medical Centre. Consultant gynaecological oncologist Dr Cheung Tak-hong told RTHK he was the operating surgeon, describing the incident as an error that should not have happened — a very basic mistake that should not have been made — and saying he is deeply sorry. He said he explained the situation to the patient and her family the same evening and apologised again at a meeting the next day, pledging to look after her; the patient has accepted his apology and chosen to remain under his care. Cheung said the patient can live normally with appropriate treatment and medication.
summary.zh_hans: 一名45岁女病人在中大医院接受腹腔镜子宫及双侧输卵管切除手术期间，两边卵巢被错误切除。中大医院顾问医生、妇科肿瘤科专科医生张德康接受本台访问时承认，他是当日施手术的医生，形容事故是不应该发生、很低级、不应该犯的错误，深感抱歉。他表示，当晚已立即与病人及家人说明情况，翌日再次在会面上承认错误并道歉，承诺会尽量照顾病人；病人已接受道歉，并选择继续由他跟进及照顾。张德康表示，病人接受适当治疗、药物后可以正常生活，不受事件影响。

summary.en: The Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism, Rosanna Law, officiated at the opening ceremony of Hong Kong Winter Wonderland in Central on November 18, kicking off the Hong Kong WinterFest organised by the Tourism Board. Building on last year's successful debut, the experience expands this year to Tsim Sha Tsui and Causeway Bay, each with its own themed light show, while the facades of several iconic Central landmarks will be illuminated from tonight until early January. Tonight also marks the grand finale of "A Symphony of Lights", which has run for 22 years and was recognised by Guinness World Records in 2005 as the world's largest permanent light and sound show, closing with a rooftop pyrotechnics display.

summary.en: Police have broken up an online shopping fraud ring selling electronic gift cards, involving at least 35 cases in which victims lost more than HK$650,000. Eleven people were arrested. The group used large numbers of real-name registered SIM cards to open shopping platform accounts and advertised gift cards at 10 to 20 per cent below market price, luring victims to transfer money to bank accounts controlled by the group before issuing invalid redemption codes. The seven men and four women arrested are aged 19 to 74 and include the suspected ringleader, the registrants of the phone numbers and platform accounts, and the bank account holders.
summary.zh_hans: 警方瓦解一个涉及电子产品礼品卡的网购骗案集团，涉及至少35宗同类骗案，受害人共损失超过65万元，7男4女被捕。警方表示，诈骗集团收取大量已实名登记的电话卡，用作开设网购平台账户，以低于市价10%至20%的价钱刊登放售电子产品礼品卡，诱使受害人转账至集团操控的银行户口，其后向受害人提供无效兑换码。被捕的7男4女年龄介乎19至74岁，包括集团主脑、电话号码及网上购物平台户口登记人，以及银行户口持有人等。
summary.zh_hant: 警方瓦解一個涉及電子產品禮品卡嘅網購騙案集團，涉及至少35宗同類騙案，受害人共損失超過65萬元，7男4女被捕。警方表示，詐騙集團收取大量已實名登記嘅電話卡，用作開設網購平台帳戶，以低於市價10%至20%嘅價錢刊登放售電子產品禮品卡，誘使受害人轉帳至集團操控嘅銀行戶口，其後向受害人提供無效兌換碼。被捕嘅7男4女年齡介乎19至74歲，包括集團主腦、電話號碼及網上購物平台戶口登記人，以及銀行戶口持有人等。

summary.en: The onshore yuan closed at a more than half-month high against the US dollar, finishing at 6.6653 per dollar, up 2 pips. The daily fixing has risen for five straight sessions to a near four-and-a-half-year high, coming in about 460 pips weaker than the market had forecast. Market watchers expect limited yuan movement ahead of the meeting of the Chinese, US and Russian leaders, while HSBC said persistent dollar strength and weak mainland economic fundamentals are holding back the yuan's rise, expecting it to hold near 6.65 per dollar by year-end with scope for mild appreciation next year.

summary.en: Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) has released its 2027 World University Rankings for Sustainability, with 11 Hong Kong universities making the list and nine of them entering the top 1,000. The University of Hong Kong ranks 161st, the highest in the city, while Hong Kong Metropolitan University rose three places to 928th. The rankings cover about 2,000 universities from 107 countries and regions; Hong Kong institutions perform strongly in employability and environmental research, with four universities in the world's top 50 for environmental research.

summary.en: TVB has invited Andy Hui to be the finale guest at its anniversary gala, "TVM Gala 2026", airing live on November 19, where he will perform a medley of classic hits with a live band. Attention has focused on whether Hui may cross paths with Kenneth Ma, who is taking part in the opening song-and-dance segment, in what would be their first time at the same event seven years after the 2019 "On Sum" scandal, when the married Hui was caught kissing Jacqueline Wong, then Ma's girlfriend, in a taxi. Hui's 33-year career stalled after he admitted he was a "broken man", but he returned to the Hong Kong Coliseum in October with three well-received concerts. Ma has said he forgave both of them long ago and bears no grudge, though many netizens have rallied behind him online, with some urging him to skip the gala to avoid an awkward scene.

summary.en: President Xi Jinping met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen during the APEC CEO Summit. Putin said safeguarding prosperity in the Asia-Pacific is a shared goal of Russia and China, and bilateral trade has substantially exceeded US$200 billion for several consecutive years, a level it will reach again this year and keep growing. Visa-free arrangements between the two countries have driven tourist numbers up 43%, and Putin said Russia-China diplomatic coordination remains stable and active, committed to building a fairer multipolar world order.

summary.en: Police have cracked a mortgage fraud case and arrested a first-year student at a local private university, who was allegedly used by a fraud ring to pose as law firm staff and meet a victim to trick them into transferring HK$800,000. The scammers first impersonated bank staff to pitch a low-interest mortgage, then claimed a high-interest fixed deposit could offset the interest, arranging to meet the victim at Elements in Yau Ma Tei on Monday to sign a mortgage application. After transferring the money, the victim called the real law firm and discovered the fraud; officers arrested the student at the scene, and the case is being followed up by Yau Tsim Police District.

summary.en: Apple suffered a large-scale network outage on 17 November, affecting the App Store, Apple Music, iCloud sign-in and payments, with thousands of fault reports logged on Downdetector. Apple confirmed the outage was caused by an internal system update that morning, that most services have been restored, and that it was not a cyberattack. Google's email service and Marriott's online platforms also saw user-reported faults on the same day; the US has recently seen a string of tech failures involving Microsoft cloud, FAA air traffic control and United Airlines, with no evidence linking them.
